svg.title: Reproduce M5 from declared sources and private requests
svg.desc: The full runbook supplies concrete paths and prerequisites. build_m3.py makes fresh pinned native Hive/PeTTa/SWI/DeTTa providers; the unchanged M4 Python lock supplies legacy-chain dependencies. <chain> is a verified pinned M4 node build, explicitly reused in the recorded run; build_m4.py can create a fresh full build when needed. verify_m5.py supports fixtures, storage, hive, legacy or all. Fixture, real-provider, missing prerequisite, executed failure and timeout classifications remain distinct. The native writer uses declared ports then exits; the operator request map contains query attributes and source barrier only. The private caller journal retains detailed result state. Public evidence publishes sanitized counts, gate results and code/build hashes only. Reading these commands or rebuilding this deck runs no integration or chain process.
svg.text: Reproduce M5 from declared sources and private requests
Fresh provider build, existing chain dependencies, then all required gates.
Accepted source; structural owner; projection owner
Declared-port consumer; private binding and placement
Actual native dispatch and recovery; no answer refs
Use --gates hive for the focused demo. Keep raw environments, private journals, queries and IDs private.
